name: Stage 57: Tullgarns slott to Kasholmen, Mörkö
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 57, Tullgarns slott to Kasholmen, Mörkö.
utilities: Tullgarn has start-side visitor parking, accessible toilets, cafe/shop/visitor-centre context, restaurant context, and limited timetable-dependent bus access via Tullgarns allé/Grindstugan, but food, tours, and transport are seasonal/time-sensitive.

Näset is the main on-stage service cluster: parking for about 15 cars, dry toilets, picnic/rest tables, grill/fireplace, firewood box, and accessible rest-area context. Sörmlandsleden says the toilets are maintained outside the trail association.

Kasholmen has official endpoint parking/access on the Mörkö side, but independent map data suggests a limited/informal parking/turning area rather than a large formal lot. Nearby Pålsundet stops are best treated as Mörkötrafiken/on-demand or live-planner transit access.

There is no verified shelter, shop, cafe, toilet, or drinking water at the Kasholmen endpoint itself. Idala Café & Lanthandel is a useful off-route Mörkö service farther east when open, but the endpoint itself is mainly a logistics point.
waterSources: The only verified on-stage water is the natural spring after Fornborgen, around 8 km in. Sörmlandsleden says water is usually available but not analyzed; treat/filter/boil and do not rely on it in drought.
Tullgarn visitor services may provide water when open, but this is seasonal/opening-hour dependent. No water source was verified at Kasholmen.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden lists 11.5 km, Naturkartan 11.4 km, and OSM relation 7448870 is a continuous 25-way chain measuring about 11.37 km despite a rounded 12 km tag. Use 11.5 km as the canonical stage distance.

Stage 57 connects Stage 56 at Tullgarn to Stage 58 at Kasholmen. It passes Djurgårdsparken, Tallbacken/Tullbotorp, Näset, Fornborgen, the spring north of Skyttorp, grave-field/cultural-remains context, Mörköbron, and Kasholmen. Draw all official relation members, including gravel roads, the short Stage 56 connector, Mörköbron, and the road section to Kasholmen. Keep both the official Tullgarn start marker and the OSM routable Stage 56/57 join because they differ by about 80 m.
No shelter was verified on Stage 57. Utsidan/forum checks and official facility lists agree that there is no wind shelter on this section; the next shelter context is on Stage 58 if continuing.

Tenting is forbidden between Tullgarns slott and Skyttorp. Sörmlandsleden notes suitable tent spots north of Skyttorp around the spring, but users must still obey local signs, reserve boundaries, pasture/private-ground constraints, and fire bans.

Tullgarn/Furholmen reserve rules: fires only at designated prepared places, pets/dogs leashed, camping prohibited in Furholmen and the inner Tullgarn zone, no collecting/breaking wood in Furholmen, and no landing on Furholmen April 15-June 30. Use Näset fireplace only when current fire rules allow.
Grazed pastures occur around Djurgårdsparken and Näset-Skyttorp; keep dogs leashed and move calmly around livestock. Hiker reports specifically mention curious cattle around the Näset pasture.

Mörköbron has no dedicated pedestrian walkway, OSM tags the bridge road as AB 569/maxspeed 80, and the bridge itself is about 186 m of tertiary asphalt plus road approaches. Traffic can be fast, especially around ferry timing; cross with high visibility and care, and use reflectors/lamp in low light or rain.

Cultural remains around the fornborg/grave-field areas are look-but-do-not-disturb sites. Swedish heritage rules prohibit disturbing, removing, covering, altering, or damaging protected ancient remains without permission.

Mörkötrafiken replaced older fixed Mörkö bus patterns, including line 785, on 2023-12-10. It is booked in the Mörkötrafiken SL app or via SL customer service, uses normal SL tickets/payment, and has no fixed timetable; do not rely on old 785 advice.

Official Stage 57 page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, and the wider Sörmlandsleden homepage warning found then concerned Stage 50:1, not Stage 57. A 2025 AllTrails note reported weaker Mörkö-side signage/maintenance; treat that as a local/anecdotal signal and check recent reports before hiking.

Wetness is condition-dependent rather than constant. Older reports describe flooding/wading near Häggenäs/Ängstugan and a wet low section after rain or spring melt, while later reports found good conditions; bring footwear that handles roots, rocks, and occasional wet low sections.

facilities.name: Tullgarn stage 57 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 57 start, connecting from Stage 56 toward Kasholmen/Mörkö.

facilities.name: Tullgarn visitor parking
facilities.description: Visitor parking by Tullgarn palace services, a short walk from the stage start. Check local signs and seasonal arrangements.

facilities.name: Tullgarn visitor toilets
facilities.description: Free toilets near the palace/parking service area, including wheelchair-accessible toilet context. Royal Palaces list daily hours around 09:00-16:30 Jun-Aug and 09:00-16:00 Sep-May; verify current opening.

facilities.name: Tullgarn cafe/shop
facilities.description: Seasonal cafe/shop/visitor-centre context in Drottning Victorias stall, with drinks, pastries/waffles, shop, and guided-tour ticket sales when open; verify current opening days and hours before relying on food or water.

facilities.name: Tullgarns värdshus/restaurant
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe context near Tullgarn, opening-hour and season dependent.

facilities.name: Tullgarn / Tullgarns allé limited bus access
facilities.description: Tullgarn/Tullgarns allé/Grindstugan access is limited and request/timetable dependent. Checked Trosabussen guidance says weekend/holiday Tullgarn service is by request, with riders from Liljeholmen telling the driver and only selected Trosa departures via Tullgarn; verify live routing.

facilities.name: Näset parking
facilities.description: Näset entrance/parking area with about 15 spaces reported by Naturkartan. Useful access/rest point on Stage 57.

facilities.name: Näset dry toilets
facilities.description: Dry toilets at Näset; Sörmlandsleden notes toilets here are not maintained by the trail association.

facilities.name: Näset picnic/rest area
facilities.description: Picnic/rest tables and accessible rest context at Näset.

facilities.name: Näset fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/grill at Näset with firewood-box context from Naturkartan/Grillplatser. Use only when fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Näsudden optional rest detour
facilities.description: Optional scenic rest/picnic context on Näsudden, off the main route. Naturkartan/secondary sources also highlight nearby Kasberget viewpoints; treat as detours, not core stage facilities.

facilities.name: Fornborgen viewpoint
facilities.description: Fornborg/high viewpoint with views toward Mörkö and Pålsundet. Approximate pin from route geometry and corroborated trip reports; cultural remains are look-but-do-not-disturb.

facilities.name: Spring after Fornborgen
facilities.description: Official natural spring after Fornborgen. Water is usually available but not analyzed; Team Vildmark saw good flow in 2019 but did not fill there. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup, especially in dry periods.

facilities.name: North of Skyttorp tenting context
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden notes suitable tent spots north of Skyttorp around the spring. This is not a formal campsite; obey signs, reserve rules, pasture/private-ground constraints, and leave no trace.

facilities.name: No tenting Tullgarn-Skyttorp
facilities.description: Camping/tenting is forbidden between Tullgarns slott and Skyttorp. Do not pitch before the north-of-Skyttorp/spring area unless current signs explicitly allow it.

facilities.name: Pasture and dog-leash warning
facilities.description: Grazed pastures around Djurgårdsparken and Näset-Skyttorp; dogs/pets must be leashed and hikers should move calmly around livestock.

facilities.name: Stage 57 wet low-section caveat
facilities.description: Older reports describe flooding/wading near Häggenäs/Ängstugan and a wet low section after rain or spring melt; later reports found good conditions. Treat as weather-dependent wetness and keep shoes/poles suitable.

facilities.name: Mörköbron road-safety warning
facilities.description: Official road/bridge section with no dedicated pedestrian walkway. OSM tags AB 569 at 80 km/h, and the bridge itself is about 186 m of tertiary asphalt plus road approaches. Traffic can be fast around Skanssundet ferry timing; use high visibility, reflectors/lamp in low light, and extra care.

facilities.name: Kasholmen stage 57/58 junction
facilities.description: Stage 57 endpoint and Stage 58 start on the Mörkö side of Mörköbron.

facilities.name: Kasholmen limited parking/access
facilities.description: Official parking/access at Kasholmen on the Mörkö side, but independent mapping suggests a limited/possibly informal turning area near the bridge rather than a large formal lot.

facilities.name: Pålsundet / Mörkötrafiken access
facilities.description: Nearby Pålsundet stop/access for Mörkötrafiken or live SL planning. Current Mörkö service is on-demand/bookable rather than a frequent fixed bus; buy a normal SL ticket separately.

facilities.name: Mörkötrafiken booking rules
facilities.description: Mörkötrafiken replaced old fixed line 785 on 2023-12-10. Book in the Mörkötrafiken SL app or via SL customer service, expect no fixed timetable and a typical wait, and use normal SL ticket/payment channels.

facilities.name: Idala Café & Lanthandel detour
facilities.description: Off-route Mörkö cafe/service-store context east of Kasholmen, useful for Stage 58 or access planning when open. Seasonal May-September; not an on-stage Stage 57 service.

facilities.name: Mörkö-side marking caveat
facilities.description: Low-confidence user-report caveat: a 2025 review described weaker Mörkö-side marking/maintenance, while official comments also report good marking. Check recent reports and keep map handy.
